query.title: Product description
query.description: Plain-language description of the wished-for product, e.g. "emerald satin midi dress that converts to a skirt, with phone pockets". Every listing is scored against this. Also used as the store search if no search query is given.
query.prefill: backpack with a built-in laptop stand

searchQuery.title: Store search query
searchQuery.description: Optional short query typed into each store's search box, e.g. "emerald convertible midi dress". Stores return little or nothing for long feature sentences, so keep this to the product noun plus a color or key feature. Defaults to the description.

spec.title: Product spec
spec.description: Optional structured spec (category, color, features, target_price_usd, ...). Scoring uses it to name what each listing is missing.

sources.title: Stores
sources.description: Which stores to search, in parallel.

maxPerSource.title: Results per store
maxPerSource.description: Keep this small to save credits.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per store (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: A store that doesn't answer in time is skipped, not fatal. Includes the store actor's start-up time.

minScore.title: Minimum score to keep
minScore.description: 80+ means it exists, 50-79 is close, under 50 is dropped by default.

sourceActors.title: Store actor overrides (advanced)
sourceActors.description: Swap the Store actor used for a source: { "google_shopping": { "actorId": "epctex/google-shopping-scraper", "input": { "queries": ["{{query}}"], "maxItems": "{{max}}" } } }. {{query}} (the store search query), {{queryEncoded}} and {{max}} are substituted; a bare "{{max}}" becomes a number.
